question: What of thousand-fold body-floods before and after?
premises: Even the shining of crores of beings in thousand-fold floods of bodies.
Yet therein too, before and after, if there is no such-like forth-arising.
inference: Cosmic floods condition on such-like arising before and after.
uncertainties: Clause closed with the next verse.
plain_english: Even the shining of crores of beings in thousand-fold floods of bodies — yet therein too, before and after, if there is no such-like forth-arising...
